schema.name: FetchMcpResource

downloadPath.description: Optional relative path in the workspace to save the resource to. When set, the resource is written to disk and is not returned to the model.

schema.description: Reads a specific resource from an MCP server, identified by server name and resource URI. Optionally, set downloadPath (relative to the workspace) to save the resource to disk; when set, the resource will be downloaded and not returned to the model.
